claude.performance_metric: $3.85bn cash divestment; Inalum majority 51.24% vs FCX 48.76%, FCX retained ~81% economic interest and operating control
claude.rationale: The slice documents a smoothly executed ownership realignment closing Dec 21, 2018 on the announced terms, with no documented disruption at the product/process interface (mining operations continued under an FCX-controlled operating committee, new IUPK license replaced the Contract of Work) — hence p4=0. It likewise documents no fracture at the process/organization interface: FCX retained operating control via the Shareholders Agreement, continued to consolidate PT-FI, and reported continuity of ~23,400 Grasberg employees with union agreements intact — hence p5=0. On t1_archetype, the arrangement created a nominal state-majority (51.24%) that nonetheless operated under FCX control (~81% economic interest, consolidation), a divergence between nominal ownership and realized control that the slice does not characterize as a disputed or incoherent controlling intent, so this is coded uncertain.

grok.performance_metric: FCX retained operating control/consolidation after 51.24% ownership realignment; $3.85bn cash; assets retained
grok.rationale: The slice documents workforce/operations continuity at the Grasberg district (approx. 23,400 employees at end-2018) with no product/process misalignment or disruption realized. It likewise records that FCX retained management control of mining operations via the shareholders agreement, continued to consolidate PT-FI, and reported no process/organization fracture over the window.

openai.performance_metric: $3.85 billion cash changed hands at completion
openai.rationale: No realized product/process disruption is documented; instead, mining operations continued under the new IUPK and FCX continued consolidating PT-FI. No process/organization fracture is documented, and FCX reported approximately 23,400 Grasberg-area employees at December 31, 2018.
